# VIEWBUG

> > VIEWBUG is a comprehensive photography community platform featuring free contests with prizes, AI-powered feedback tools, photo galleries, and monetization opportunities for photographers of all skill levels.

VIEWBUG combines photo competitions, community engagement, and professional tools including AI critique, portfolio websites, photo editing, and print services. The platform connects photographers with judges from major publications like National Geographic while providing equipment and prize opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Photo Contests
- Photography Community
- Free Competitions
- Contest Prizes

## Photo Contests & Competitions

- [Photo Contests & Photography Competitions](https://www.viewbug.com/photo-contests): Main photo contests platform with free competitions and prizes
- [Judges Directory](https://www.viewbug.com/judges): Directory of professional judges from National Geographic and major publications

## Community & Discovery

- [Fame - Discover and Share Photos](https://www.viewbug.com/fame): Photo gallery and community-curated trending photography showcase
- [About VIEWBUG](https://www.viewbug.com/about-us): About page describing VIEWBUG's photo community and services

## Photography Tools & Services

- [Photochat AI](https://www.viewbug.com/photochat.ai): AI photography assistant providing feedback and gear recommendations
- [Critique Service](https://www.viewbug.com/critique): Expert photo critique service from professional photographers
- [Darkroom Photo Editor](https://www.viewbug.com/darkroom): Photo editing software with AI enhancement and color grading tools
- [Portfolio Websites](https://websites.viewbug.com): Free portfolio website builder for photographers with templates

## Photo Monetization & Printing

- [Gigs Marketplace](https://www.viewbug.com/gigs): Photo monetization marketplace for print-on-demand and digital sales
- [Professional Printing](https://www.viewbug.com/prints): Professional photo printing service with museum-quality fine art prints

## Resources & Education

- [Photography Blog](https://www.viewbug.com/blog): Photography tips, contest updates, and seasonal photography guides

## Optional

- [Member Sign In](https://www.viewbug.com/members): Member authentication and account login portal
- [Virtual Currency Store](https://www.viewbug.com/mycoins/store): Account login for virtual currency store access
